question: How many times must the Gāyatrī be recited to the deities after dedication?
premises: The offerings are dedicated to the deities
The Gāyatrī mantra is recited as part of the rite
inference: After dedicating, one should recite the goddess Gāyatrī thrice to the deities.
plain_english: Having dedicated them, one should recite the goddess Gāyatrī thrice to the deities.
